headline: Magneto's surprising new powers unlocked in Marvel lore
post:
The Master of Magnetism has officially unlocked game-changing new abilities. According to Screen Rant, recent Marvel comics reveal that Magneto's mutant powers are now directly tied into his immune system. This allows his body to automatically defend itself and unilaterally weaponize magnetism without him even being conscious.

During a recent issue of Fantastic Four, Marvel's First Family shrank down to fix Magneto's DNA and help cure a dangerous illness. X-Men's Beast later explained that the unconscious Magneto's body generated electromagnetic attacks and gravitons to ward off threats. This incredible evolution means even knocking the powerful mutant out might not take him out of a fight!

What other Omega-level mutant abilities do you want to see explored next? 🧬✨

#XMen #Magneto #MarvelComics
original_title: Marvel Confirms Permanent New Superpowers for X-Men's Magneto

headline: James Gunn addresses Harley Quinn's DCU future
post:
James Gunn recently spoke about the future of the DC Universe continuity and the status of Harley Quinn. According to Gunn, almost the entire movie is considered canon, with only the future of the character remaining as an asterisk. 

Gunn stated that Margot Robbie's potential return to the role depends on the actor's interest in continuing. Updates will follow as more information becomes available.

headline: DC Reveals The Tragic Backstory Of Cadejos
post:
Hey everybody! We finally have the full history of the most imposing new addition to Justice League Unlimited. According to Screen Rant, "Justice League: The Dark Realm Special #1" reveals how Andrés Aguilar gained his fiery, werewolf-like form. 

After a demonic beetle-like monster kidnapped his young daughter Victoria, Andrés agreed to bond with the Cadejos entity to gain the power needed to rescue her. This issue follows Andrés, along with heroes like Blue Beetle and Zatanna, as they team up to close a portal to the Dark Realm. Andrés even relinquishes control of his body to the entity to pull off the mission and save another little girl. 

Meanwhile, the comic also plants narrative seeds for the potential return of Darkseid, who has been conquering other universes. Even with this looming threat, Andrés and Cadejos remain determined to find Victoria someday. 

What are your thoughts on this new character? 🐺✨

#JusticeLeague #DCComics #Cadejos
original_title: DC Explains Full Backstory Of Justice League's Best New Hero
